item.title: Hamas 'weaponised' sexual violence in 7 October attacks, Israeli investigation says
item.description: The most comprehensive report of its kind details harrowing cases of sexual attacks which it says were systematic.

item.title: Snack giant switches to black and white packaging as Iran war hits ink supplies
item.description: The effective closure of the Strait of Hormuz has severely disrupted global supplies of energy and petrochemicals.

item.title: Trump's 'Golden Dome' will cost $1.2tn and might not stop all-out missile attack
item.description: That pricetag is nearly seven times higher than Trump's initial estimate, found an independent budget office.

item.title: Lebanon says two paramedics among 13 killed in Israeli strikes
item.description: Lebanon's health ministry says the paramedics were carrying out a rescue mission in Nabatieh in response to an earlier attack that killed one person.

item.title: No sign of larger hantavirus outbreak, says UN health agency
item.description: The situation could still change and there might be more confirmed cases, warns the head of the World Health Organization.

item.title: Uganda's president sworn in for record seventh term
item.description: Yoweri Museveni, 81, won disputed elections in January to extend his 40-year rule.
